decision_question: Which of two exact configured coding-agent stacks should be used for this repository and task stratum under the same total budget?

primary_estimand.name: usable implementation rate by configured stack
primary_estimand.description: Practical comparison of complete configured systems; component differences are preserved and no model-only causal attribution is permitted.
primary_estimand.aggregation: task-stratified usable implementation rate with cost, latency, critical failures, and rework reported as a Pareto frontier

conditions.label: Configured coding stack A
conditions.delta_from_baseline: Reference stack with a frozen model, runtime, prompt, tools, skills, context policy, permissions, workflow, and budget.

conditions.label: Configured coding stack B
conditions.delta_from_baseline: Alternative complete stack. The study asks which exact system to use, not which individual component caused the difference.

contamination_notes: Tuning may use adaptation repositories but not holdout repositories or hidden acceptance tests.

budget.description: Match the complete stack budget rather than per-call budgets; count every model call, tool action, retry, critique, and integration stage.

adaptation_boundary.description: Freeze both complete stack manifests and tuning allowance before holdout execution.

selection_rules: Select a stack only for the declared task strata and budget.
Report a Pareto result when quality, cost, latency, and rework do not yield one dominant stack.
Never restate the stack comparison as model-only superiority.
stop_rules: Stop on unauthorized effects, unmatched task access, or unbounded retries.
Retry only operational invalidity under the same frozen stack.
Do not tune either stack after holdout inspection.

independence_claim.label: maintainer_evaluated
role_overlaps: Kizz owns the stack configurations, fixture, runner, and practical selection decision.
